description:
Join to claim special GTA Online benefits, access a selection of Rockstar Games titles, and much more — all part of the best way to get the most out of your GTA Online experience on PC with GTAV Enhanced.

Cash Every Month
GTA+ Members get a bonus of GTA$500,000 every month, delivered upon billing and deposited automatically into their Maze Bank account. Members can also play select GTA Online missions and modes to earn accelerated GTA$, and take advantage of special GTA+ Shark Cards with 15% extra bonus GTA$.

The Vinewood Club
Gain exclusive access to The Vinewood Club’s amenities, with a vehicle that is available to claim for free each month at The Vinewood Car Club showroom, along with a rotating selection of distinct vehicles to utilize in Freemode and purchase at a Member-exclusive discount.

Members also get 100 Personal Vehicle slots at The Vinewood Club Garage in Downtown Los Santos, with its own Vehicle Workshop floor where you can apply Hao’s Special Works Upgrades, Benny’s Conversions, Drift Tuning, and more. Plus, quickly access a wide range of Member benefits with the convenient Vinewood Club App right on your in-game phone.

New Monthly Benefits
Enjoy a rotating suite of claimable Member benefits in GTA Online, including multipliers for GTA$ and RP across various game modes, access to dazzling Chameleon Paint schemes, property upgrades, and stylish in-game apparel options. 

And More... 
There’s also a wide range of persistent GTA Online benefits for GTA+ Members, with CEO/VIP abilities accessible at no cost via the Interaction Menu, shorter cooldowns and waived costs for Downtown Cab Co.’s Taxi services, and the roving Gun Van featuring special weapons and discounts is always blipped on the map for GTA+ Members. 

GTA+ Games Library
GTA+ Members get access to download and play a rotating assortment of classic Rockstar Games titles on PC and mobile for as long as they’re included in GTA+.

Access to Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced for PC is required to receive the GTA Online benefits. The benefits and games, including any online features, included in GTA+ are subject to change, see for more information.
